data.body: Investigation COMPLETE (BASIC, dso:investigator-basic, high confidence). ROOT_CAUSE: merge-to-main-pr.sh:1448 RETURN trap uses rmdir '$_lockdir' which silently fails on the non-empty lockdir (pid file written at line 1400 by _restage_acquire_lock makes it non-empty), so the mkdir-lock ${TMPDIR}/dso-restage-main.lock.d is NEVER released on _restage_execute return. Stale lockdir with a dead PID accumulates; when that PID is reused/appears-live, _restage_acquire_lock spins 60s then returns 1 -> _restage_execute RC=1 with no NO-OP message -> t_restage_noop_emits_noop + t_restage_noop_rc_zero FAIL. The checkpoint's ambient-staged-* hypothesis was DISPROVED empirically (outer staged-* branches do not bleed into the fixture; cd $work isolates correctly). Inconsistency note: line 1387 (stale-lock reclaim) already uses rm -rf; only the RETURN trap at 1448 uses rmdir. FIX: 1448 rmdir -> rm -rf. Complexity TRIVIAL; testing_mode=RED (new test asserting lock release on return). Hypothesis Validation Gate: PASS (3 confirmed dynamic tests, root-cause-consistent, names actionable artifact).
